channel.title: Installing Puppet :: CIS 527 Textbook
channel.description: Note The video refers to Puppet version 6, but we’ll be using OpenVox 8. For the lab assignment, you’ll want to install OpenVox 8 and not Puppet 6. This changes the URL used to get the release package and some of the commands - see the assignment page for more information. The basic process is otherwise mostly the same. Resources Installing OpenVox on Linux Installing OpenVox on Windows About OpenVox OpenVox Getting Started OpenVox System Requirements OpenVox Documentation Video Script To begin work on Lab 2, you’ll need to install Puppet Agent on your new VMs. This video will walk you through that process.
